_info.text: This adapter manages Python environments. Processes are started by js-controller.

_installing.label: Building an environment
_installing.trueText: yes -- the adapter it belongs to is stopped until it finishes

_check.label: Check prerequisites
_check.title: Looks for uv, a writable environment directory, internet access and the state of every installed Python adapter. Changes nothing.

_rebuild.label: Rebuild environments
_rebuild.title: Rebuilds every Python environment from scratch, picking up the newest Python SDK. Each adapter is stopped while its environment is replaced and started again afterwards.

confirm.title: Rebuild every Python environment?
confirm.text: Every Python adapter will be stopped, its environment rebuilt and the adapter started again. This takes a few seconds per adapter and needs internet access.

autoBuildEnvironments.label: Build missing environments automatically
autoBuildEnvironments.help: Creates a venv as soon as a Python adapter is installed whose environment is missing.

downloadUv.label: Download uv automatically
downloadUv.help: uv creates the virtual environments and brings its own Python interpreters. If it is not installed, this adapter fetches a pinned version into iobroker-data/py/.bin/.

uvPath.label: Path to uv
uvPath.help: Leave empty to search PATH. uv ships its own interpreters, which avoids depending on an outdated system Python.

editableInstall.label: Install linked to sources
editableInstall.help: An editable install lets edits to an adapter's Python sources take effect on the next restart, instead of only after reinstalling. 'Automatic' turns it on for adapters whose directory is a symlink or junction, which is how a working copy is linked into an installation.
